protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: CVE.org is PUBLISHED and Adobe describes pre-fix ServiceInputProcessor::getConstructorData() as processing every constructor parameter type. At 2.4.8-p2, attacker-controlled nested REST values reach convertValue(); non-simple types recurse through _createFromArray() and objectManager->create(). The fix restricts constructor hydration to simple types and Api\Data objects, directly closing that object-instantiation path.
